details.question: PayNow 转账要收钱吗？
details.rewritten: PayNow 转账要收钱吗？
details.hyde: 通过 PayNow/FAST 转账至本地账户一般免手续费；海外电汇等跨境转账可能另收费，具体以本行收费表为准。

details.question: What's the charge for sending a TT to Malaysia?
details.rewritten: What's the charge for sending a TT to Malaysia?
details.hyde: TT charges to Malaysia vary by remittance channel, currency and account type. They typically include a cable/handling fee and may be lower via online banking. Please refer to our current fee schedule before sending.

details.question: 你们的 exchange rate 是怎么定的？周末会不会不一样？
details.rewritten: 你们的 exchange rate 是怎么定的？周末会不会不一样？
details.hyde: 汇率按银行参考国际市场报价及成本厘定，含点差；周末及非交易日可能采用不同牌价或顺延更新，以交易时系统显示为准。多币种账户兑换亦适用。
top_reranked: 外币兑换与外币刷卡费用

details.question: I paid in USD on Amazon with my Visa, why was there an extra 3.25%?
expected: 外币兑换与外币刷卡费用
details.rewritten: I paid in USD on Amazon with my Visa, why was there an extra 3.25%?
details.hyde: A 3.25% cross-border/foreign currency transaction fee may apply when your Visa payment is processed outside your billing currency or overseas, even if Amazon prices the item in USD. To reduce this, consider using a multi-currency account or a USD-denominated card where available.
kept: 外币兑换与外币刷卡费用
top_reranked: 外币兑换与外币刷卡费用

details.question: 在日本 ATM 拿钱要多少 fee？
details.rewritten: 在日本 ATM 拿钱要多少 fee？
details.hyde: 在日本ATM取款手续费取决于卡种及ATM运营方，通常含本行海外取现费与当地附加费；如使用多币种账户可减少汇兑费用，取款需使用PIN，具体以收费表为准。

details.question: statement 上面有一笔看不懂的小额 charge 是什么？
details.rewritten: statement 上面有一笔看不懂的小额 charge 是什么？
details.hyde: 该笔小额扣款可能为账户服务费、海外交易或多币种账户相关费用、商户预授权/验证交易。请核对交易描述；若非本人授权，请立即通过官方渠道联系我们冻结卡并查询。

details.question: 信用卡年费可以免吗？
expected: 银行卡年费与其他卡费
details.rewritten: 信用卡年费可以免吗？
details.hyde: 信用卡年费能否豁免视卡种及促销政策而定；达标消费或指定活动可申请减免，未达标按标准计收。您可通过手机银行（经OTP验证）查询并申请豁免。
kept: 银行卡年费与其他卡费
top_reranked: 银行卡年费与其他卡费

details.question: What's the difference between PayNow and FAST?
details.rewritten: What's the difference between PayNow and FAST?
details.hyde: PayNow is an overlay on FAST that lets you send instant funds using a mobile number, NRIC/FIN or UEN. FAST is the underlying interbank instant transfer system, which requires the recipient’s account number.

details.question: FAST transfer 一般几分钟会到？
details.rewritten: FAST transfer 一般几分钟会到？
details.hyde: FAST 转账一般实时到账，最快数秒，通常不超过数分钟；实际到账时间以收款银行处理为准。

details.question: How do I send money to my mum's bank account in China?
details.rewritten: How do I send money to my mum's bank account in China?
details.hyde: Please use our Overseas Telegraphic Transfer service via online banking. Add your mother’s China bank account as a beneficiary (name, account number, SWIFT/BIC), confirm charges and exchange rate, then authorise with OTP. Funds will be debited from your multi-currency account.

details.question: 我朋友在美国要汇钱给我，要给他什么资料？
details.rewritten: 我朋友在美国要汇钱给我，要给他什么资料？
details.hyde: 请提供收款银行名称及地址、SWIFT/BIC代码、账号、户名；如使用多币种账户，请确认币种及账号。朋友可通过海外电汇汇入。

details.question: Why can't I add Binance as a payee?
details.rewritten: Why can't I add Binance as a payee?
details.hyde: Binance is not a supported payee. To meet regulatory and risk requirements, we do not permit adding cryptocurrency exchanges as payees. Please use PayNow, FAST, GIRO or an overseas wire for eligible transfers; your PIN/OTP is required to authorise them.

details.question: 我想一次转 SGD 10,000 给朋友，可以吗？
details.rewritten: 我想一次转 SGD 10,000 给朋友，可以吗？
details.hyde: 可以。通过 PayNow/FAST 转账须在账户每日限额内，并以 OTP/PIN 验证；若单笔限额不足 SGD 10,000，请先调整限额或分行办理。海外电汇适用于跨境付款。

details.question: My transfer got returned, what usually causes that?
details.rewritten: My transfer got returned, what usually causes that?
details.hyde: Transfers are usually returned due to incorrect beneficiary name/account details, a closed or restricted account, name mismatch, exceeded limits, failed OTP/PIN verification, or invalid currency/account details for overseas remittance, PayNow, FAST, GIRO or a multi-currency account. Please verify the details and retry.

details.question: 新卡收到了要怎么开通？
details.rewritten: 新卡收到了要怎么开通？
details.hyde: 请登录手机银行“卡片管理”激活新卡，完成OTP验证并设置PIN；激活后可用于PayNow、FAST、GIRO及多币种账户，海外电汇服务请另行开通。

details.question: My new card still hasn't arrived after two weeks
details.rewritten: My new card still hasn't arrived after two weeks
details.hyde: We’re sorry your new card has not arrived. Cards are usually delivered within 7–10 business days. Please check your mailing address in the app and contact our card services hotline for delivery status or a replacement. Once received, activate it using the OTP and set your PIN. Do not share your OTP or PIN with anyone.

details.question: 我的 PIN 输错三次了，现在用不了
expected: 修改 PIN 与 PIN 被锁
details.rewritten: 我的 PIN 输错三次了，现在用不了
details.hyde: 您的 PIN 因连续输错三次已被锁定。请通过手机银行使用 OTP 重置 PIN，或携带有效身份证件至网点解锁。
kept: 修改 PIN 与 PIN 被锁
top_reranked: 修改 PIN 与 PIN 被锁

details.question: Why does my card keep getting declined overseas?
details.rewritten: Why does my card keep getting declined overseas?
details.hyde: Your card may be declined overseas if overseas usage is not enabled, your travel notice is missing, the transaction exceeds your limits, your multi-currency account balance is insufficient, or fraud monitoring requires PIN/OTP verification. Check your card controls and limits in the app, enable overseas usage, or contact us.

details.question: ATM 把我的卡吃掉了
details.rewritten: ATM 把我的卡吃掉了
details.hyde: 请勿离开ATM，立即致电本行客服热线报备吞卡；携带有效身份证件至该ATM所属网点领卡。如无法取回，可办理挂失及补卡。切勿向他人透露PIN或OTP。

details.question: My card expires next month, do I need to apply for a new one?
details.rewritten: My card expires next month, do I need to apply for a new one?
details.hyde: No. We will automatically issue a replacement card before expiry and mail it to your registered address. Activate it via OTP and set your PIN; your old card will then be deactivated.

details.question: 可以给我太太办一张 supplementary card 吗？
details.rewritten: 可以给我太太办一张 supplementary card 吗？
details.hyde: 可以。您可为主卡配偶申请附属卡，提交双方身份资料并经本行审批后寄发；附属卡交易计入主卡账户，激活需OTP验证。

details.question: Is your debit card Visa or Mastercard?
details.rewritten: Is your debit card Visa or Mastercard?
details.hyde: Our debit cards are issued as Visa debit cards; Mastercard debit cards are not offered. For overseas transactions, card controls or replacement requests, please use Internet Banking or visit a branch. PIN and OTP may be required for activation and certain transactions.
top_reranked: 外币兑换与外币刷卡费用

details.question: Can I open an account if I'm 15?
details.rewritten: Can I open an account if I'm 15?
details.hyde: If you are 15, you may open a minor/joint savings account with a parent or guardian’s consent and joint signatory arrangement. Certain services—such as PayNow, FAST, GIRO, overseas remittance, and multi-currency account features—may be restricted until you meet the bank’s age requirement. ATM card/PIN and OTP access may also be limited.

details.question: 开户需要什么证件？没有 Singpass 可以吗？
details.rewritten: 开户需要什么证件？没有 Singpass 可以吗？
details.hyde: 开户请携有效身份证件及地址证明；无Singpass可到分行人工核验办理，PayNow、FAST、GIRO等服务或需后续激活。

details.question: The app keeps rejecting my selfie during verification
details.rewritten: The app keeps rejecting my selfie during verification
details.hyde: Please ensure good lighting, remove glasses/hats, keep your full face in frame, and follow the on-screen prompts. If selfie verification still fails, retry using OTP/PIN or visit a branch. Never share your OTP or PIN.

details.question: 我搬家了，地址要怎么改？
details.rewritten: 我搬家了，地址要怎么改？
details.hyde: 您可登录网上银行/手机银行，在个人资料中更新住址，并按提示完成OTP验证；如无法在线办理，请携有效身份证件至任一网点更新。

details.question: I can't remember my internet banking password
details.rewritten: I can't remember my internet banking password
details.hyde: Reset your internet banking password via the “Forgot Password” link on the login page. Verify your identity using an OTP sent to your registered mobile number, then create a new password. Never share your password, PIN or OTP with anyone. Contact us if you need assistance.

details.question: 我想 close 我的 savings account
details.rewritten: 我想 close 我的 savings account
details.hyde: 您可携带有效身份证件到任一支行办理销户；请先清零余额、结清费用，并取消相关GIRO/PayNow安排。部分情况需OTP验证。

details.question: Can I hold Japanese yen in my account?
expected: 多币种账户支持的货币
details.rewritten: Can I hold Japanese yen in my account?
details.hyde: Yes. Eligible customers can hold Japanese yen in a multi-currency account. JPY balances support FX conversion and overseas wire transfers; FAST, PayNow and GIRO are available only for supported currencies. PIN/OTP may be required for transactions.
top_reranked: 多币种账户支持的货币

details.question: 你们可以存比特币吗？
expected: 多币种账户支持的货币
details.rewritten: 你们可以存比特币吗？
details.hyde: 本行暂不支持比特币等加密货币存款，亦不接受通过海外电汇、PayNow、FAST或GIRO存入相关资产。多币种账户仅支持法定货币，详情请登录网上银行查询。
kept: 多币种账户支持的货币
top_reranked: 多币种账户支持的货币

details.question: 定期存款利率是多少？
details.rewritten: 定期存款利率是多少？
details.hyde: 定期存款利率随币种、存期及金额而异，并会按市场调整。请登录网上银行/手机银行或前往网点查询最新利率；多币种账户各币种利率可能不同，最终以办理时公布为准。
top_reranked: 银行卡年费与其他卡费

details.question: How do I apply for a home loan?
details.rewritten: How do I apply for a home loan?
details.hyde: Apply online via our Home Loan page: submit your details, upload income documents and verify with OTP. After approval, set up GIRO for repayments. A specialist will guide you on eligibility and rates.

details.question: 你们的分行几点开门？
details.rewritten: 你们的分行几点开门？
details.hyde: 我行分行柜台通常周一至周五 9:00–16:30 营业，周六 9:00–12:30，周日及公共假期休息；各分行略有不同，请以官网分行查询为准。

details.question: Does my credit card come with travel insurance?
details.rewritten: Does my credit card come with travel insurance?
details.hyde: Travel insurance may be included with selected credit cards, subject to card type, eligibility and activation. Please review your Cardmember Agreement and Benefits Guide or contact us to confirm coverage, limits and exclusions before travelling.

details.question: 那 FAST 呢？
details.rewritten: FAST 转账的手续费是多少？
details.hyde: 通过本行网上银行/手机银行办理 FAST 转账通常免手续费；经柜台或人工渠道办理可能按收费表收取，详情请查阅最新收费表。

details.question: what if I forgot the PIN?
expected: 修改 PIN 与 PIN 被锁
details.rewritten: What if I forgot the PIN for my new card?
details.hyde: You can reset your new card’s PIN securely via the mobile app using OTP verification, at an ATM, or at any branch. If you are overseas, please contact Customer Service for assistance. Never share your PIN with anyone.
kept: 修改 PIN 与 PIN 被锁
top_reranked: 修改 PIN 与 PIN 被锁
